CP0.name: Current feature evidence
CP0.minimumDecision: Retain only public feature claims backed by current source evidence and fresh normal-input journeys on the immutable 5.2 candidate.

CP1.name: Deterministic fixed world
CP1.minimumDecision: Retain the production fixed-location Earth authority with deterministic Shortbread transport, optional exact Overpass gap-fill, and explicit forced-outage evidence at the representative release locations.

CP2.name: Worldwide transport and vehicle contact
CP2.minimumDecision: Retain the compiled road/bridge/tunnel authority, reviewed bridge spans over mapped water, mapped share-link road identity, and measured four-wheel vehicle contact without claiming geometry beyond published provider data.

CP3.name: Buildings, facades, entrances, and interiors
CP3.minimumDecision: Retain mapped indoor geometry on each available source level and generated fallback floors with working stairs, elevator, collision, keyboard/touch entry, exit recovery, and reload teardown. Explicit mapped connector semantics and moderated indoor overlay publication remain staged beyond 5.1 and are not public claims.

CP4.name: Player, Backpack, Journal, progression, and controls
CP4.minimumDecision: Ship one Explorer event and profile authority across the Backpack, Journal, Field Guide, fieldwork, games, making, travel, community, and companions; retain tested touch profiles with reset and reload recovery. Full cross-device Journal sync and per-action remapping remain staged and are not 5.2 claims.

CP5.name: Urban Sandbox
CP5.minimumDecision: Retain the equipment, vehicle, responder, custody, mapped-facility, and room-authority journeys proven by normal input. Universal full-body embodiment and broader sandbox simulation remain staged and are not 5.1 claims.

CP6.name: Missions, engagement, crafting, and economy
CP6.minimumDecision: Retain Field Today, daily and weekly Expeditions, seasonal surveys, progression, and existing games in the same Explorer Journal. Credits, mapped-business exchange, connected property transactions, and conserved Earth-to-ship materials must use the existing Backpack, cargo, property, and backend authorities.

CP7.name: Live GPS Field Expeditions and regional ecology
CP7.minimumDecision: Retain the reviewed Baltimore 60-taxon slice and add ten source-bounded 12-entry regional slices so every built-in Earth destination has attainable field play. Expansion entries remain reference presentation unless media or models are separately reviewed; make no worldwide ecology, abundance, or live-animal-presence claim.

CP8.name: Water, Ocean, fishing, and environmental evidence
CP8.minimumDecision: Ship one honest shore/boat virtual fishing authority; connect underwater schools before describing water fish as unified.

CP9.name: Multiplayer and Quick Build
CP9.minimumDecision: Retain authenticated rooms and one Quick Build path for persistent local and room Blocks. The removed game editor and unfinished overlay-authoring interface must not be loaded or presented as released features.

CP10.name: Performance, memory, and data use
CP10.minimumDecision: Enforce numeric budgets on the physical Apple M1/8 GB desktop and a clearly labeled 390x844 Chrome touch-regression tier; do not claim physical-phone battery, thermal, or sustained FPS evidence until a phone is measured.

CP11.name: UI, accessibility, presentation, and release identity
CP11.minimumDecision: Require keyboard and 390x844 touch completion of every retained primary flow, honest public claims, inspected runtime captures, and one immutable 5.2 identity.
